0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 13th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Southwest) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West) on a three-game losing streak, with a 0-1 home record and an 0-2 road record. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The Pelicans trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and they were swept 0-3 by Denver in the 2025-26 series.
